name: VO₂max
rangeNote: Depends strongly on age and sex. Healthy Norwegian adults measured on a treadmill averaged (men / women): 54.4 / 43.0 at 20–29, 49.1 / 40.0 at 30–39, 47.2 / 38.4 at 40–49, 42.6 / 34.4 at 50–59, 39.2 / 31.1 at 60–69 and 35.3 / 28.3 at 70 and over. Watches estimate VO₂max from heart rate and pace; a lab test measures it.
summary: The most oxygen your body can use during hard exercise, per kilogram of body weight: a measure of aerobic fitness. Higher fitness goes with fewer heart and metabolic risk factors.

high.meaning: A high VO₂max for your age means good aerobic fitness.

low.meaning: A low VO₂max for your age means lower aerobic fitness. In the Norwegian study, people below the median were five to eight times more likely to have a cluster of cardiovascular risk factors than the fittest quarter.

sources.title: Aerobic capacity reference data in 3816 healthy men and women 20-90 years
Peak oxygen uptake and cardiovascular risk factors in 4631 healthy women and men
